newsitem.title: UK: Reed warns on sterling strength.
newsitem.headline: Reed warns on sterling strength.

text.p: Anglo-Dutch publisher Reed Elsevier said on Wednesday that if the strength of sterling is sustained it will have a "marked effect" on results, particularly in the first half.
Reed chairman Ian Irvine told the company's annual general meeting that the adverse translation effect does not affect the underlying performance of the businesses.
"Trading conditions in Reed Elsevier's main markets are little changed since the 1996 preliminary results announced last month," he told shareholders.
Reed said that the continued development of new electronic and hard copy information products may constrain the historical rates of margin improvement.
The company derives nearly one fifth of its revenues from electronic products and services.
"We are confident that this investment should be rewarded by strong revenue growth in the future," said Irvine.
